en.headline: Man has finger severed by cardboard baler at Kwai Chung paper plant
en.dek: A 69-year-old worker was taken to Princess Margaret Hospital after the machine cut part of his right ring finger while he was compressing cardboard this morning.
body: Police said a 69-year-old man surnamed Tsang was injured shortly after 10:40 a.m. at a ground-floor waste paper processing facility on Kwai Tak Street in Kwai Chung.

He was operating a cardboard baler to compress paper when the machine severed the upper part of his right ring finger. Colleagues immediately called for help. Paramedics treated him at the scene and took him, along with the severed segment, to Princess Margaret Hospital. He remained conscious throughout.
Police classified the case as an industrial accident and cordoned off the machine for investigation. The Labour Department has been notified and is inquiring into the precise cause.

zh.headline: 葵涌廢紙廠男工遭紙皮打包機切斷無名指
zh.dek: 69歲曾姓工人今早操作機器壓縮紙皮時右手無名指上截被切斷，清醒送往瑪嘉烈醫院治理。
body: 警方表示，今早約10時40分後，葵涌葵德街地下一間廢紙處理場發生工業意外，一名69歲曾姓男工人受傷。
當時他正操作紙皮打包機壓縮紙皮，機器切斷其右手無名指上截。工友即時報警，救護人員到場為傷者包紮，並連同斷指送往瑪嘉烈醫院。傷者全程保持清醒。
警方將案件列作工業意外，並封鎖涉事機器搜證。勞工處已接獲通報，正調查意外原因。
